svg.title: Where the viewer gets its pictures
svg.desc: Where the viewer gets its pictures: 7 nodes, 7 connections. The viewer shows pictures the Plotwork engine already drew: files in your repository, and links to hosted diagrams that update when a new version is published. Nodes: - Group: Your repository - checkout.diagram (Text an agent or you wrote), storage - Plotwork CLI or Action (Draws on every change), function - checkout.svg (Carries its source), storage - Group: Plotwork - Organisation library (Private diagrams), database - Stable link (cdn.plotwork.dev/l/), gateway - Embed link (cdn.plotwork.dev/o/, your sites only), gateway - Group: Your page - plotwork-diagram (Web component or React), client Connections: - checkout.diagram to Plotwork CLI or Action: drawn by - Plotwork CLI or Action to checkout.svg (stored data line): writes - checkout.svg to plotwork-diagram: src or import - Organisation library to Stable link (asynchronous line): publishes - Organisation library to Embed link: shares - Stable link to plotwork-diagram: live - Embed link to plotwork-diagram: live

g.text: Text an agent or you wrote
